observations.trace: LimbShape::shape calls LimbArmorDesign::validate before its match. The validated greave calf height is450..800 permille, so neither calf height nor one minus calf height is zero at the examined WGSL branch. JointCupDesign validates JointExtension and rejects an extension on RaisedCop; validated extension has lame_count1..4, and joint-cup code handles lames==1 separately before using lames-1 for the multi-lame branch. Besagew validates RadialFluting, whose count4..48 and twelve samples per spoke produce48..576 candidate columns, then the selected spaulder applies a96-column minimum.
observations.remaining: Source and bounded integer reasoning only; no shape, mesh, frame, shader, test or device ran. Other ratios, frame finiteness, geometric intersections, arbitrary helper callers and native acceptance remain open.

observations.trace: The selected public textures entry validates Metal and restricts size32..1024 before size*size. This bounds texels at1,048,576; a three-word finish buffer has at most12,582,912 bytes, and scratch_density at most3000 with five draws per scratch bounds scratch_draws at15,000. The private bake function itself does not perform that validation.
observations.remaining: Arithmetic derives from selected source contracts; no buffer, image, texture, device or build was run. Other direct internal callers, GPU limits and device execution remain open.

observations.contract: Connected metal and native readback error boundaries
observations.trace: Original independent Adler346 extended original engraving error ownership family to MetalGpu::device_error, which formats reusable GPU errors into String. The current native Buffer::read converts the native asynchronous mapping error to anyhow text before the MetalGpu wrapper formats it again; its WASM branch checks the mapping outcome but replaces the underlying error with a generic message separately. Original q2265 and q2266 identify distinct earlier first operations, not aliases of the later outer wrapper.
observations.remaining: No I/O, image, GPU operation or failure ran. Classifications of all underlying kernel/context/native failures and all error-family aliases remain open. The historical q2266 wording says the outcome is discarded; the current source instead propagates a generic error, so only the underlying cause is discarded.

observations.contract: Metal sequence use across finish, scratches and per-texel roughness
observations.trace: Scratch id.y=0 starts at lcg_skip(seed,0), then advances once before its first draw. Finish layer0 lattice (i=0,j=0) uses lcg_skip(seed,1), and the same metal.seed is supplied to both passes; the source-defined state is equal without executing the generator. For default scratch_density500, scratch_draws=2500; on an admitted1024 texture the per-texel roughness index1,046,076 and finish layer1 lattice (i=0,j=0) both use step1,048,577. Finish layers themselves remain separated by their documented stride.
observations.remaining: Exact integer/source relationship, not a generated texture, shader execution, observed visual artifact or proof that statistical independence is required. Intended sharing policy, effect and preservation of seeded behavior remain open.

reconnected_historical_findings.qualification: Original Adler346 extends the same engraving error family to outer MetalGpu formatting; original native and WASM first-operation questions remain distinct.

new_current_candidates.qualification: New source-derived shared-state question, not a proven defect or output observation.
